craft_notes: Sthāyin: unsmeared-act (jīvanmukti stated as condition: living-freed, acting-unsmeared). Rows: row 2 (acting→not smeared). Close: god (vocative — the claim addressed, not asserted to air). Rejected: 'while alive' gloss — killed: living kept as state (jīvan is condition, not time); 'unstained' — killed: not smeared kept (the smear-word is contact, not color).

lines: Living even, freed; acting even — not smeared:
this body — supreme great-lord's, O god.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jīvann api vimukto 'sau kurvann api na lipyate | idaṃ yadi vapur deva parāyāś ca maheśvara

reads_against.argmap: Is the freed one smeared while acting? → Freed while living, acting unsmeared — supreme body of the great lord.
c1_essence: Freed yet living, unsmeared: supreme great-lord body.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra with śānta (resolve closing the practice arc)
